text:
City,
already so far away!

Far away beside the sea: harbor afternoons
and the wandering desolation of the docks.
The rising tides will stubbornly return
for those distant hours.

And they will become a murmur,
a pulse struggling as it falls asleep,
when the lights of night appear
above the sea.

Deeper, ever deeper,
you go with me, city,
like a sunken love
beyond repair.

Sometimes a wave and at other times silence.

translation.title: The Outskirts (III)
